requested_event.user_description: First engine hotfire, described as 10 seconds; user recalls early May
requested_event.likely_matching_event: 2026-05-03, based on user recollection and team's subsequent review; exact run identity not independently verified

material_assumptions.density_source: Conditional density from the hot brick's reported initial mass, 82.8 g, divided by its nominal 2 × 3.5 × 0.5 in volume. Bare-specimen tare and individual dimensions are unverified. Applying this density to the sleeve additionally assumes a matching formulation, cure, and porosity; no sleeve density was measured.

expanded_what_if_assumptions.purpose: Conditional cylindrical volume and mass bookkeeping only; not a heat balance, pyrolysis/char-growth model, engine heat history, or validated prediction.
expanded_what_if_assumptions.recession_reference: The measured coupon dimple depth, approximately 1/8 inch (3.175 mm conversion), is hypothetically imposed on the affected sleeve area; sleeve recession was not measured.
expanded_what_if_assumptions.coverage_definition: A uniform fraction of original bore surface extending through the modeled radial layers, representing an axial-length or azimuthal fraction. The rest remains unchanged virgin material. Layer-edge interactions and spatial gradients are omitted.

no_char_example.note: The density ratio has no effect when char volume is zero. This is an explicit no-char case, not a default for missing measurements.

expanded_what_if_assumptions.model_example_char_and_coverage_treatmen: Use the reference char thickness, density ratio and coverage independently of the rig-model depth. No char evolution is inferred from flux or time. Existing rig-model input limits are enforced; these examples do not validate transfer to an engine.
expanded_what_if_assumptions.reference_area_energy_treatment: q_reference * time * original_bore_area * affected_fraction is reported only as reference-area energy bookkeeping, not absorbed sleeve energy or a closed energy balance.
expanded_what_if_assumptions.range_interpretation: Selected cases are not confidence intervals or proven physical bounds. Unknown measurement, formulation, density-transfer and geometry errors are additional. No char thickness or density is supplied as an implicit default.

confirmed_hot_brick_test.run_association_source: User confirmed in this conversation on 2026-09-27 that the 82.8 to 73.9 g data belong to the approximately 2.25x-flux ablative test.
confirmed_hot_brick_test.dimensions_status: Previously confirmed nominal size, not individual specimen metrology
confirmed_hot_brick_test.depth_status: Measured dimple depth, approximately reported as 1/8 inch on the slide; user confirmed it was measured on 2026-09-27. Instrument, datum, and uncertainty remain undocumented; 3.175 mm is the unit conversion, not measurement precision.
confirmed_hot_brick_test.depth_confirmation_source: User reply: a measured dimple depth

event_evidence.preexisting_cracks_status: Team inference from post-test observations, not verified pre-test measurements
